info.name: F5 BIG-IP DNS - Sequence (lab)
info.description:
Run top to bottom with the Collection Runner. Set the 'password' variable (Current value) once.
Q. Questions: run folder 'A > Q Questions' after sign-in, then open Q.99 > Visualize and send the table back.
A. Read-only sequence: sign in, identify, HA/sync, monitoring, partitions, all data.
B. Change sequence (LAB ONLY): create, modify, transaction, errors, save, clean up.
C. Sign out.  Z. Optional one-time steps: run by hand, not in the Runner.
Turn off SSL certificate verification in Postman settings for the lab certificate.

exec: if (!password) { console.warn("Set the collection variable 'password' (Current value) first."); return; }
body: { mode: "raw", raw: JSON.stringify({ username: pm.collectionVariables.get("username"),
if (err || res.code !== 200) { console.error("F5 auto-login failed", err || res.code); return; }

variable.value: ["M1 Who owns this lab BIG-IP, and may we switch on the DNS (GTM) module (services restart for a few minutes)?", "M2 The lab is shared (other partitions exist): may we create partition Portal_Lab and test objects, and delete them afterwards?", "M3 May we create a separate API user for the portal, and with which role?", "M4 Can a second BIG-IP VE be added in a GTM sync group, to test sync between sites?", "M5 Is there (or can there be) a BIG-IQ in the lab?", "M6 Testing laptop: are Postman, curl and jq installed, and may files be copied to and from it?", "M7 Will the portal (Docker) run on this laptop, or does another machine need network access to the BIG-IP?", "M8 Lab certificate: may certificate checks stay off, or is there a CA file to use?", "M9 SBI production: which F5 objects hold the records (Wide IPs, ZoneRunner zone records, DNS Express)?", "M10 SBI production: is there a BIG-IQ managing the BIG-IP DNS devices (address and version)?", "M11 SBI production: for a domain with several IPs, are the IPs different at DC, DR and AZ?", "M12 SBI production: which device takes the changes that sync automatically, and how is the sync confirmed?", "M13 SBI production: which BIG-IP version runs at DC, DR and AZ?"]

exec: const add = (q, a) => { const s = JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get("qa") || "{}"); s[q] = a; pm.collectionVariables.set("qa", JSON.stringify(s)); console.log(q + ": " + a); };
let b = {}; try { b = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) {}
const find = (o, key, out = []) => { if (o && typeof o === "object") { for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(o)) { if (k === key) out.push(v); find(v, key, out); } } return out; };

const dc = JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get("serverDc") || "{}"); const pools = b.items || []; const rows = pools.map(p => { const m = ((p.membersReference || {}).items || []).map(x => x.name.split(":")[0]); const d = [...new Set(m.map(s => dc[s] || dc[s.replace(/^\/Common\//, "")] || "?"))]; return { name: p.name, members: m.length, dcs: d }; }); add("Q13a A pools", String(rows.length)); add("Q13b Pools with members in more than one data center", String(rows.filter(x => x.dcs.length > 1).length)); add("Q13c Pools with more than one member", String(rows.filter(x => x.members > 1).length));
